purpose: Mentor a junior; teach 作戦/指揮/基盤/加工/図る/銘柄/売買/プラン

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ビジネスは、作戦が命だよ。
lines.style: mentor sharing a maxim, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 現場の指揮の取り方、勉強になります。
lines.en: How you command the field is instructive.
lines.style: learning junior appreciating, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まず、強固な基盤を築くことだ。
lines.style: mentor giving a principle, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 加工や物流の知識も必要ですね。
lines.en: Knowledge of processing and logistics is needed too.
lines.style: junior noting scope, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 常に効率化を図る意識を持って。
lines.en: Always keep the mindset of pursuing efficiency.
lines.style: mentor advising, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 投資では、銘柄選びが難しいです。
lines.en: In investing, picking stocks is hard.
lines.style: junior admitting difficulty, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 売買の判断は、データに基づいてね。
lines.style: mentor cautioning, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 次の事業プラン、私に任せてください。
lines.en: Leave the next business plan to me.
lines.style: eager junior stepping up, tone holding steady through the whole line
